title: The most interesting startups right now want to get you off your phone
description: While the AI fundraising machine keeps breaking its own records, some founders are building in the other direction.  Mirror founder Brynn Putnam just raised money for Board, a startup focused on bringing people together through in-person games and social experiences. Cyberdeck creators are going viral crafting whimsical DIY computers that literally encourage users to touch grass. Unlike the AI-free browser crowd, this doesn’t just feel
summary_cn: 当前AI领域融资热潮持续，但一些有趣的初创公司反其道而行之，专注于让人们放下手机、回归线下社交。例如，Mirror创始人Brynn Putnam新创立的Board公司，通过组织面对面游戏和社交体验来促进人际连接。这反映了在AI过度数字化背景下，产品创新开始关注平衡数字与真实世界，满足用户对深度社交和脱离屏幕的需求。商业价值在于捕捉反算法、反成瘾趋势的细分市场，产品经理可从中获得关于用户心理与场景设计的启示。
